index.title: Shop
index.heading: Healthy greens, made easy. Everything you need to grow your own.
index.body: Seeds ship from our shelf; racks, trays and snacks arrive in a few days.
index.plansPrompt: Looking for a weekly box instead?

category.body: Delivered on the same Saturday run as the greens.
category.empty: No {category} are listed right now — check back shortly.

racks.body: Built to order in the size you need — the height, the width and the number of levels are all yours to pick. Three ranges, and the difference between them is what a level is made of.

shelf.name: Shelf racks
shelf.line: Slotted steel angle uprights with a pressed steel plate bolted on at every level. A closed shelf, so it carries anything — not only trays.
shelf.imageAlt: A four-level rack of orange slotted steel angle with white pressed steel shelf plates bolted on
shelf.jointAlt: Close-up of the bolted joint where a white pressed steel shelf meets the orange slotted steel angle post
shelf.includedAlt: What's included: shelves sized to the rack height, four slotted angle posts, nuts and bolts, and wall-mounting bushes

angle.name: Open-frame angle racks
angle.line: The same slotted angle with no plates at all. Every level is an open rectangle with a third rail down the middle, which braces the span and is where an LED tube mounts.
angle.imageAlt: A three-level rack of orange slotted steel angle with no shelf plates, each level an open rectangle with a rail down the middle
angle.jointAlt: Close-up of the bolted joint where an orange slotted steel angle rail meets the upright post
angle.includedAlt: What's included: four slotted angle posts, nuts and bolts, and wall-mounting bushes

pipe.name: UPVC pipe racks
pipe.line: One inch UPVC pipe and push-fit connectors, chosen for steadiness rather than price. Light to move, nothing on it to rust in a wet grow room, and it wipes clean. The dearest of the three.
pipe.imageAlt: A three-level rack built from white UPVC pipe and moulded connectors, each level an open rectangle braced by a support leg underneath
pipe.jointAlt: Close-up of the 4-way elbow connector joining the UPVC pipes at a corner
pipe.includedAlt: What's included: UPVC pipes, 4-way elbow connectors, and end caps
pipe.withMatsAlt: A three-level UPVC pipe rack with a black drainage cell mat covering each shelf
